verdict.rationale: Vestd is a UK equity-management and cap-table SaaS platform, not an AI agent or assistant host. Consuming tools from plugged-in MCP servers is the MCP-client role, which belongs to agent products, so this story's axis does not fit Vestd's product type. Nothing in the evidence pack (cap table, share issuance, data rooms, HRIS integration, llms.txt probe) shows an in-product AI agent or any MCP client capability that would make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
